title: alangium lamarckii var. glandulosum
intro: Alangium lamarckii var. glandulosum, commonly known as the Himalayan Alangium, is a medicinal plant species native to the Himalayan region. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its antidiabetic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to manage conditions such as diabetes, arthritis, and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to modulate glucose metabolism, reduce inflammation, and scavenge free radicals, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Alangium lamarckii var. glandulosum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
